name: What should I prepare before relaunching my expired listing?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before relaunching my expired listing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before relaunching your expired listing, it's beneficial to gather feedback from previous showings, address any necessary repairs or maintenance, and consider decluttering or staging your home. Having a clear understanding of your property's current condition and your selling goals will streamline the process. Kelby Contreras - Realty ONE Group Evolution provides a pre-listing checklist and offers recommendations for property enhancements to maximize appeal and prepare your home for a successful relaunch.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before relaunching, gather feedback, address repairs, and consider decluttering or staging your home.
